title: Third sealed test: pre-registered plan
written: Before any third-test capture was opened. Hashed in FREEZE_v3.json.

versions.ebr: Current settings in ebr_config.json: scan cap and readable SMB.
versions.repair: Current EBR plus the verify-before-delete loop, repairing only with rules published before each capture.

cases: IoT-23 scanning-family captures from 50 MB upward, first 300 MB where larger, plus WRCCDC files at fixed positions in the 2017 and 2018 file lists.

screen.rule: A case is scan-heavy if payload-free flows would take at least 30 percent of the packet budget at a 5 percent cap with the scan cap removed.
screen.when: After the freeze and before any Suricata scan of these captures. It reads packet headers and first bytes only, and prints flow counts and shares.
screen.use: Only H1 is restricted to scan-heavy cases. All other hypotheses use every scored case.

primary_measure: Attack signature recall, because repeated scans have not changed it. Alert instance recall is secondary and reported with a measured noise band.
noise: The forensic_test run and the first round of the repair run scan identical EBR selections, so their gap measures scan noise.
analysis: Means across scored cases. Paired differences by case, with 95 percent bootstrap intervals from resampling cases, 10000 replicates, as in earlier reports.
decision_rule: A hypothesis is supported at a cap only if the mean difference favours it and the 95 percent interval excludes zero. A case with no attack alerts on the complete capture is not scored.

hypotheses.H1: On scan-heavy cases, EBR with the scan cap keeps more attack signatures than the first version at the 5 and 10 percent caps.
hypotheses.H2: Repair keeps more attack signatures than EBR alone at every cap.
hypotheses.H3: Repair keeps more attack signatures than IDS-triggered capture with fill at every cap.
hypotheses.H4: Repair does not lower recall of later-published rules by more than 5 points on average at any cap.
hypotheses.H5: The hidden-family estimate predicts later-rule recall with a lower mean absolute error than always guessing the mean. Needs at least 10 usable case and cap pairs.

not_tuned: Repair settings stay as in the prototype: boost 1000, 64 neighbours, two repair rounds. No setting changes after this plan is hashed.
disclosures: The WRCCDC 2018 slices are from the same event as a capture used in development, at different hours. They are unseen data, not a new network.
